dedupe_keys.name: high resolution circa 2020 map of urban lakes in china culd

description: This dataset maps the urban lakes of China around 2020 as polygons, with about 1.11 million lakes of at least 0.001 km2 totalling about 2,130 km2 inside urban areas. Researchers at the Nanjing Institute of Geography and Limnology of the Chinese Academy of Sciences produced it from Sentinel-2 imagery acquired between 2019 and 2021 and described it in a Scientific Data descriptor published in December 2022. Accuracy against reference samples is reported as 81.85 percent by area and 93.35 percent by lake count. Coverage is the urban areas of mainland China. Format and access: shapefiles downloadable from figshare without registration. Licence: CC-BY-4.0; free. Caveats: very small ponds near the size threshold and lakes under shadow or turbid water are the main error sources, and the map is a single epoch. Urban lakes act as stormwater storage and cooling blue infrastructure, so the layer supports flood retention, heat mitigation and green-blue planning studies. Related catalogue records are the Global Lakes and Wetlands Database v2 and the UBGG-3m blue-green-gray maps of 36 Chinese cities.
